retrieval.rag_summary:
Trade Select Aluminium Glass
Foil Tape (AGFT100) is a 100mm wide heavy-duty reinforced sealing tape featuring
an aluminum foil facing reinforced with glass fiber cloth and coated with an
aggressive pressure-sensitive adhesive. Distributed under the Trade Select
umbrella for building and HVAC applications, it provides high tensile strength,
puncture resistance, and an airtight, vapor-tight seal across reflective
sarking, wall wraps, and ductwork.
